title: Реализовать safe ConfirmationService в PHP/Dart
summary: Реализовать additive safe prepare/commit facade в PHP и Dart, который derives every security-critical input from P2.2 ports and exposes structured fail-closed outcomes.
why: Typed contracts alone не устраняют caller-controlled `ConfirmationProtocol::commit`; supported path должен физически не иметь параметров для clock, actor, descriptor, authorizer, policy mode/revision, approval evidence или dual-control override. `RAG:—`.

include: `ConfirmationService` prepare/commit requests limited to action/tool/actual arguments/preview or token/actual arguments; trusted dependency resolution; exact record/token/arguments/descriptor/policy/approval checks; policy-selected separation/quorum; context-rich current authorization; structured P2 error codes; legacy low-level deprecation/internal marker; shared manifest-driven PHP/Dart tests.
exclude: Atomic cross-process consume; new token claims/format/key rotation; database adapters; tool side effect; generic idempotency; event-store durability; removal of legacy classes/exports; public docs/release.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: Public service accepts no injectable per-call security value. Prepare obtains actor/time/descriptor/policy/authorization target from trusted dependencies, fails if commit principal cannot be resolved, persists a bound confirmation record through the declared port, then invokes the legacy protocol. Commit verifies signed token, exact authoritative record, arguments and current descriptor; validates policy identity/revision/compatibility and approval evidence; then sends a context-rich request to the injected authorizer. Missing/unknown/mismatch/deny is fail-closed with stable code/category and redacted external context. Current process-local spend remains explicitly baseline-partial until P3; service must not claim durable replay safety. Frozen `2026-08` bytes stay unchanged.
guidance: Use one private assembly path for authorization request and one table-driven refusal map in each language. Keep pre-presentation binding checks separate from the legacy presentation/consume boundary so P3 can replace consume without changing service semantics. Legacy direct `commit` remains callable only for compatibility and focused protocol tests, is marked expert/internal/deprecated, and documents that it is unsafe as an application boundary. No generic `catch` may turn security denial into allow or untyped state errors.
